apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Deckbox: a Comp box no longer stays locked when the list is busy, and taking an item off the list frees its box. Phone: labels are sent again if the cloud is busy for a moment.
